title: USF Event Contract Schema
description: Draft JSON Schema for event and message contracts. Each declares its kind (event-workflow-kinds), a payload schema reference, producer and consumers, ordering expectation, idempotency key, retry and dead-letter policy, retention, and whether it is canonical or test-only. Events MUST have a contract before emission and MUST NOT be invented in implementation code. USF claims no full AsyncAPI compliance until concrete artefacts exist. Governs the ontology concept Event. lifecycleState draft; not active.

canonical.$comment: true = canonical event; false = test-only event.

allOf.$comment: An event/message contract must carry payload, ordering, idempotency, DLQ, and retention semantics before emission.
